text: DP World is listed as a state-owned enterprise; its infobox cites Reuters reporting that the company returned to full Dubai state ownership.
short: DP World is a Dubai state-owned enterprise.

source.name: Wikipedia – DP World
source.note: Wikipedia infobox Type field, citing the Reuters headline 'DP World returns to full state ownership, takes on $8.1 billion debt'.

additionalSources.name: DP World – DP World to Delist from Nasdaq Dubai (press release)
additionalSources.quote: DP World will be 100 per cent owned by Port and Free Zone World, which in turn is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Dubai World.
